decisions.body: OpenSpec artifacts for your questions are updated. Implement them.
decisions.author: tracker

report.question:
own-git-invocation-policy: 8.3 is done and ticked (floor split: GitVersion.FLOOR 2.56.0, BOX_FLOOR 2.51.0; specs green, PIT killed). Two tasks are blocked.

(1) Task 8.4 (CI's git, UX3, design D11): the premise of D11 'Cost' (design.md:324-326) and UX3 (proposal.md:207, :235) is false. The git-core PPA has NO git 2.56: Launchpad API (~git-core/+archive/ubuntu/ppa, getPublishedSources) lists 1:2.55.0-0ppa1 as the newest for jammy, noble, resolute and stonking (checked 2026-10-21). CI's ubuntu-latest prints git 2.55.0 (run 39484184528). So the PPA install brings CI and scripts/linux-runner/Dockerfile only to 2.55.0 < GitVersion.FLOOR: scripts/linux-specs.sh now fails at the image's floor check, and CI's build would refuse every factory start. Sources that do have 2.56.0: Homebrew (x86_64_linux bottle; ubuntu-latest ships /home/linuxbrew), alpine:edge, a source build from kernel.org. Task 8.5 also tells operators to use the PPA, so it carries the same false premise. Alternative zero (install nothing): CI and the Linux runner stay at 2.55.0 and every factory-start spec there is refused. Options ranked: waiting for the PPA is an unbounded stall of CI; Homebrew or a pinned source build both meet the floor at a per-job install cost. Any option revises D11/UX3, which only /opsx:update may do. Current working copy: ci.yml (build) and pitest-nightly.yml (mutation) got a PPA-install step + a 'git meets the floor' step (>= 2.56); the Dockerfile floor check is raised to 2.56 (image does not build now); glossary says git >= 2.56. I would replace the PPA steps with the chosen source in both workflows and the Dockerfile, and reword 8.5's operator remedy accordingly.

(2) Task 4.2: code is done (AdversarialLocalConfig, initWorkingRepo/initPlainWorkingRepo, assertNothingPlantedRan, AdversarialLocalConfigSpec green), but the task also requires updating .claude/rules/testing.md ('Git fixtures are adversarial by default'), which this stage may not edit. The proposed paragraph is in temporary-docs/gnomish/github-oinsio-gnomish-factory-102/testing-md-proposal.md. The task cannot be ticked until a human applies it (or moves that sub-item out of the task).
options: CI and Linux runner: install git 2.56 from Homebrew (brew install git, prepend to PATH); operators: Homebrew or a source build; update D11/UX3/8.4/8.5 accordingly; I apply testing.md myself and tick 4.2
CI and Linux runner: build git 2.56.0 from a pinned, sha256-verified kernel.org tarball (cached in CI); update D11/UX3/8.4/8.5 accordingly; I apply testing.md myself and tick 4.2
Use alpine:edge/other base for the Linux runner and Homebrew in CI; update D11/UX3/8.4/8.5 accordingly; I apply testing.md myself
Other: I will decide the git source and revise the artifacts myself
